LanguageData.Gun_SP89_RWP.label: SP89
LanguageData.Gun_SP89_RWP.description: The SP89 is a compact, easy-to-handle submachine gun, optimized for close-quarters combat. It features a high rate of fire and moderate damage output, making it ideal for skirmishes and room-clearing operations. Its lightweight design allows for excellent maneuverability, but it sacrifices range and accuracy for rapid, close-range engagement. Ideal for those who need to strike fast and retreat quickly.
